svg.text: AgentLens · what it is, and how to install it
A Microsoft 365 Copilot agent that audits every AI agent in your tenant. Start at the top if this is new to you.
Elliot Margot
e-margot.ch
1 · WHAT IT IS
You ask a question in Copilot chat. Four things sit between your question and your tenant. Understanding this chain explains every install step below.

svg.text: 3 · THE ONE RULE - read this before you trust a number
Zero and unknown are different answers.
An administrator makes retire-or-keep decisions from this output, and a security reviewer will ask what it can change. Both collapse if one number is invented. So a store
that could not be read is never rendered as “0 agents”. It is reported as not_connected, naming the source, the reason and the fix.
Consequences you might mistake for missing features: there is no demo or sample mode, and nothing is ever estimated to make output look complete.
4 · HOW YOU INSTALL IT - 12 steps, of which 6 need a signed-in human
Work left to right. A 🔒 gate is a step Microsoft requires a person for - everything else is scripted. Each step lists the check that proves it worked.

svg.text: 5 · WHAT EACH SKIPPED GATE COSTS
None of these produces a wrong number. Each produces a not_connected source with the fix attached - which is the design working, and still worse than having the data.

g.text: every agent reported as an orphan
zero Copilot Studio agents, no error
no per-agent cost, no savings line

the agent. An Agent 365 licence gates the
Neither is a bug in the install.

svg.text: HOW TO READ THIS
Scripted - the installer does it for you
🔒 Gate - Microsoft requires a signed-in human
the check that proves the step landed
A step is not done because a command exited 0. It is done when its effect has been read back from the service. That rule is why this install is slow, and why the
numbers it finally reports can be trusted.
